title: Proof by Induction
description: Show it for the first case, and show that each case gives the next: then it holds for all of them, like dominoes. Unlocks the Proof Certificate.

puzzle.goal: Write the sum S of the first n squares, 1 + 4 + 9 + ... + n², the formula that induction proves.
puzzle.name: Sum of squares
puzzle.method: True for n = 1 (1 = 1·2·3/6); adding (n + 1)² to the formula for n gives the formula for n + 1.
